question.text: If a Category III AIF breaches its leverage limit during a trading day, by when must it inform investors?

answer.text: Before 10:00 AM on the next working day
At the end of the quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Per prudential norms, the Cat III AIF must send a report to ALL investors before 10:00 AM on the next working day after a leverage breach. The Trap: Immediate same-day reporting is not mandated; 7 days/quarter is too late. Cross-Exam Context: Custodian also reports to SEBI on the same T+1 timeline.
